reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specified the feature; the summary records the choice to hide the count at zero.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read package.json and README before relying on project checks.

incremental_slices.note: It added a failing e2e test, implemented the feature, then ran the checks.

self_review.note: It reviewed the diff before committing and summarized correctness and scope considerations.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks, followed by rerunning checks, is shown.

test_experiment.note: The new test failed before implementation, and a deliberate mutation later caused both e2e tests to fail.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The summary says the README did not need updating.

scope_kept.note: The agent listed unrelated issues as follow-ups and left them untouched.

verification_story.note: The summary names checks and results, and reports browser screenshots and what they showed.

hand_check.note: It seeded data and inspected the changed footer in a running browser before reporting done.
